title: To Cultivate and Keep It
text: Then the LORD God took the man and placed him in the Garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.

title: Whatever the Man Called It
text: … And whatever the man called each living creature, that was its name.

title: Bone of My Bones
text: This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh …

title: Did God Really Say?
text: Did God really say, ‘You must not eat from any tree in the garden?’

title: He Will Crush Your Head
text: He will crush your head, and you will strike his heel.

title: Garments of Skin
text: And the LORD God made garments of skin for Adam and his wife, and He clothed them.

title: Springs Welled Up
text: But springs welled up from the earth and watered the whole surface of the ground.

title: Pleasing to the Eye
text: Out of the ground the LORD God gave growth to every tree that is pleasing to the eye and good for food.

title: Where There Is Gold
text: The name of the first river is the Pishon; it winds through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold.

title: The Four Rivers
text: The name of the third river is the Tigris; it runs along the east side of Assyria. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.

title: Wonderfully Made
text: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made …
